data.title: Jobcenter: Bürgergeld approval for December 2026 to November 2027
data.summary: The Jobcenter Beispiel-Oderland approved Bürgergeld (basic income support) for Ronny Musterspree for the period from 1 December 2026 to 30 November 2027, with a monthly entitlement of €1,041.30 (including €478.30 for housing and heating). The person must submit the 2025 utility cost statement (Nebenkostenabrechnung) from their landlord by 8 January 2027.
data.explanation: This is a benefit decision (Bescheid) from your Jobcenter confirming your Bürgergeld for 1 December 2026 to 30 November 2027, paid monthly at €1,041.30 (heating costs are only a provisional estimate for now). Please send your landlord's 2025 utility cost statement (Nebenkostenabrechnung) by 8 January 2027 so the heating portion can be finalised. If you think the amount is wrong, you can file a written objection (Widerspruch) with the Jobcenter — the app will show you the deadline for this. If you do nothing and agree with the decision, no further action is needed beyond submitting the utility statement. Keep this letter, as it documents your current benefit entitlement.
